implementation.targetScope: Checkout sessions.create and signed snapshot webhook verification used by the payments caller; Node 24/Bun native fetch and crypto.

applicationBaseline.usage: Checkout creation and checkout.session.completed snapshot events; no other Stripe SDK resource calls in checked backend source.

changes: Replace the generated SDK resource graph with scoped native fetch and HMAC operations. The app 17.7 dependency graph is removed; current upstream 23.1.0 itself already has no runtime dependencies.
Authenticate raw webhook bytes and reject invalid UTF-8, malformed or duplicate timestamps, nonfinite tolerance and timestamps beyond either side of the allowed window.
Bound request structure and response buffering, prohibit credential-bearing redirects and preserve idempotency keys across retries.
omitted: Thin event notifications, custom crypto providers, callback-style methods, agents/proxies, telemetry, API event emitters and generated SDK-wide types.
